create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running average and current value of metrics
create_NaiveMeter: create a NaiveMeter instance to track per-index values alongside running averages
calculate_accuracy: calculate top-1 classification accuracy between model outputs and target labels
aggredate_video_accuracy: aggregate per-frame softmax predictions into video-level top-k accuracy scores
aggredate_video_map: aggregate per-frame predictions into video-level mean average precision scores
